# Interpolate 1D Fourier

![Interpolate 1D Fourier function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/interpolation/09-interpolate_1d_fourier.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Periodic Fourier resampling: type0 means requested output size n, type1 means n times the input length. Preserves amplitude and Nyquist symmetry; dt_out=dt_in*N/M. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Interpolate 1D Fourier**

Rééchantillonne un signal réel par Fourier avec gestion explicite du point final et de Nyquist.

</details>
